name: a command that merely CONTAINS the one form passes (||true and friends)
expect: every divergent shape is refused — one finding each

name: the one form tolerates trailing arguments
expect: a trailing argument is a second shape too

name: a registered hook that does not exist passes
expect: the one form naming a hook that does not exist is refused

name: an unregistered, unexplained hook file passes
expect: a hook file nobody registers and nobody explains is refused

name: every file in the hooks directory counts as a hook
expect: a non-.sh file in the hooks directory is not a hook

name: a stale UNREGISTERED entry for a registered file passes
expect: a stale UNREGISTERED entry — the file is registered — is refused

name: a stale UNREGISTERED entry for a missing file passes
expect: a stale UNREGISTERED entry — no such file — is refused

name: ZERO hook commands reports a pass instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} registers ZERO hook commands.
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} registers ZERO hook commands.
expect: ZERO command hooks is CANNOT RUN — a zero over nothing is not a pass

name: a malformed hooks block reports a pass instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path}: {exc}. Treat this as NOT RUN."]
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path}: {exc}. Treat this as NOT RUN."]
expect: a malformed hooks block is CANNOT RUN, not a crash

name: a settings file that is not an object reports a pass
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} is not a JSON object.
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} is not a JSON object.
expect: a settings file that is a JSON array is CANNOT RUN, not a crash

name: hook files are listed from the REPO, not the root given
expect: a registered hook that exists under ROOT passes

name: main() ignores the root it is given
edits: code, messages = check(root / SETTINGS_REL, root, unregistered)
code, messages = check(REPO_ROOT / SETTINGS_REL, REPO_ROOT, unregistered)
expect: main() over a compliant world exits 0

name: an unknown hook type is skipped again (backlog #365)
expect: ⭐ a hook entry with type None is CANNOT RUN, not skipped (backlog #365)

name: an empty UNREGISTERED reason is accepted again (backlog #365)
expect: ⭐ an UNREGISTERED entry with an EMPTY reason is refused (backlog #365)
